lines.prompt: What is the fanout of primary input n5? List all gates that n5 drives directly.

golden.notes: Fanout count 35 is the only hard requirement (verified directly against test05.v: n5 feeds 33 AND-type gates plus g248 OR and g300/g443 NOT). The name list is NOT a hard must_names requirement because full-score Team3 listed no names in-log, giving only count=35 plus an explicit claim that the complete list was written to testcase/test05/fanout_gates.txt. Accept count=35 with either (a) the in-log name list or (b) an explicit list-written-to-file claim. If names are listed, they must match the 35-name set in the reference exactly (Teams 2/4/7 list this identical set; Team7 adds gate types). No DFFs are involved; the design has 0 DFFs.
